hook: Do tables ki dosti ka [[dhaaga]]: Foreign Key

slides.title: Foreign Key = [[rishta]]
points: Ek table ka column, **doosri table** ki key point kare
slides.note: Order bolta: "main **customer 1** ka hoon". FK check karta: woh hai bhi? 🔍

slides.title: Child pe [[FK lagao]]
slides.code:
CREATE TABLE orders (
  order_id INT PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id INT,
  amount INT,
  FOREIGN KEY (customer_id)
    REFERENCES customers(id)
);

slides.title: FK ka [[pehra]]
slides.note: Customer 9 exist hi nahi karta. **Bhoot order** allowed nahi 👻

slides.title: Parent delete [[kiya]] to?
points: **ON DELETE CASCADE**: orders bhi saath gaye
slides.note: CASCADE powerful hai, par **soch samajh ke**. Ek delete, sau rows gayab 💥

slides.why: Aarav ke orders abhi bache hain → FK **error**. Pehle child, phir parent
